claims.claim: Nikon Z fc, retro-inspired SLR-style mirrorless camera
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show 'Nikon' and 'Zfc' engraved on the retro-styled body with dials matching this description.
Sensor and its spec are not visible in any photo; this is a known spec for this model but cannot be confirmed from the images themselves.

risks.risk: Shutter count / sensor wear not visible, affects remaining lifespan
risks.proof: Screenshot of shutter actuation count from camera menu or a shutter-count app reading
risks.if_unproven: price as high-use/unknown wear, worst case

risks.risk: Autofocus and general functional condition unknown
risks.proof: Short video clip showing camera powering on, autofocus locking on a subject, and shutter firing

risks.risk: Lens glass condition (scratches, fungus, dust) on TTArtisan 35mm lens
risks.proof: Macro photo of front and rear lens elements under raking light
risks.if_unproven: price as lens with possible optical defects

risks.risk: Whether a kit lens (e.g. Nikkor Z 28mm) is included or only the third-party TTArtisan lens
risks.proof: Photo showing all lenses laid out together with the camera
risks.if_unproven: price as body + TTArtisan lens only, no kit lens

risks.proof: Screenshot of battery info/cycle count from camera menu

risks.risk: Missing accessories: memory card, USB cable, strap, original box/receipt
risks.proof: Photo of full accessory bundle including cables, strap, and any box/receipt
risks.if_unproven: price as bare body + lens + charger only, no extras

risks.risk: Hidden physical damage (dents, corrosion, mount wear) not visible from these angles
risks.proof: Additional photos of all sides, base plate, and lens mount flange close-up
risks.if_unproven: price as cosmetically unverified, assume moderate wear

proof_requests: Video of camera powering on, menu navigation, autofocus test, and shutter firing
Screenshot of shutter actuation count and battery cycle count from camera menu
Macro photos of front and rear lens elements under light
Photo of all included accessories (cables, strap, memory card, box, receipt) laid out together
Close-up photos of lens mount flange and camera base plate for wear/corrosion
response.reason: Identity (Nikon Zfc body with TTArtisan lens and basic accessories) is confirmed by the witness, so a worst-case price can be set, but functional and completeness claims remain unverified pending proof.
